page_title: LAZ 1-1 MON | Lazio v Monza 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Rosario Abisso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Luis Alberto (Lazio) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+5' Adam Marusic (Lazio) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Nicolo Rovella (Lazio), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
88' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
86' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
85' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
84' The substitution has been made. Mirko Maric has replaced Lorenzo Colombo (Monza).
84' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza).
82' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
80' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
78' A substitution has been made. Patrick Ciurria goes off and Samuele Birindelli (Monza) comes on.
76' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Mattia Zaccagni and he is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
76' Substitution. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) replaces Danilo Cataldi.
76' Samuele Vignato (Monza) has a goal ruled out for offside!
76' Monza take a short corner kick.

74' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Ivan Provedel stops the ball from going inside right post. The ball is out of play. Monza win a corner kick.
74' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
72' A fine solo run by Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar.
72' Luis Alberto (Lazio) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
72' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
71' Andrea Colpani (Monza) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Ivan Provedel makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
69' Here is a change. Dany Mota is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Samuele Vignato (Monza).
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) for Armando Izzo.
68' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Matias Vecino (Lazio) heads on.
66' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
65' The resulting set piece from Monza is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' A long ball forward to Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monza are going to take it.
61' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) but poses no threat.
59' Matias Vecino (Lazio) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
58' Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
57' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
55' We are about to witness a substitution. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is replacing Elseid Hysaj.
55' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Matias Vecino (Lazio) replaces Matteo Guendouzi.
55' Substitution. Gustav Isaksen did his best and is replaced by Felipe Anderson (Lazio).
54' Luis Alberto (Lazio) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
52' Substitution. Lorenzo Colombo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
52' Luis Alberto (Lazio) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
50' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Ivan Provedel scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
49' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
47' A pass into the penalty area from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is intercepted by the defence.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
44' A player from Lazio commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Dany Mota (Monza) for a tough tackle.
39' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Armando Izzo (Monza) for his blatant foul.
36' 1 - 1 Goal! Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
33' The corner from Andrea Colpani (Monza) is hurriedly cleared.

32' Andrea Carboni (Monza) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Good work from Monza as they win a corner.
32' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luis Alberto (Lazio) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
30' Monza showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
27' Luis Alberto (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Rosario Abisso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
23' Lovely cross from Georgios Kyriakopoulos to find Patrick Ciurria (Monza) deep in the box, but he steers his header well wide of the right post.
19' A long pass finds Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
18' A goal, which was scored by Dany Mota (Monza), was disallowed due to offside.
18' Dany Mota (Monza) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
16' Monza control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ciro Immobile (Lazio) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Michele Di Gregorio no chance!
12' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
12' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for an infringement. Lazio are about to take a penalty!
11' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
8' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
6' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and it's Andrea Colpani (Monza) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Luis Alberto (Lazio).
3' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

2' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Ivan Provedel was alert and the score remains the same.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
